status: Versioned eligibility repair frozen before any C0 v1 fitting or probe outputs; C0 v0 failed during prepare before fitting.
question: How linearly decodable are the existing E2 source labels from global mean embeddings of the earlier slot, later slot, or their ordered concatenation?
scope: Independent CPU development diagnosis on exposed E2 data; not a change to E3 sampling, transformations, thresholds, or scientific verdicts. No confirmatory primary decision and no claim of temporal understanding.

population.flood_train_test: flood_qa_v0/items.jsonl Q1 with fold train/test, expected 3198/1371 items
population.contract: sen12_gp_contract/sample_contract.jsonl; exact E2 quality-top12 of 15, chronological retained-index mapping
population.validation: not used; no hyperparameter, epoch, threshold, or model selection
population.id_integrity: Apply exact E2 existence eligibility first: cache path exists, and S2 tile is in the date contract. Record every candidate id/tile/partition/phen/cache path/source path/eligible/reasons in eligibility_audit.json before indices or feature extraction. Eligible IDs must be unique and match original counts; test ID/metadata/source answer must exactly match all three historical E2 real_all files. Ineligible rows are disclosed exclusions, never silently dropped.
population.train_provenance_limit: Historical E2 saved only aggregate train counts, not a train-ID manifest. C0 freezes reconstruction IDs and current source hashes at prepare; this does not independently prove historical E2 train IDs were identical.
population.disjointness: No train/test tile overlap or flood event / landslide fold overlap. Complete paired pos/neg tiles checked. Original train hard negatives retained.
population.feature_usage: Class labels used only for supervised fitting. No dates, item IDs, tile IDs, event/fold labels, kind, or predictions as features.
population.eligibility_freeze: Eligibility audit is SHA256-pinned in prepare manifest. Source JSONL/contract hashes and complete eligibility membership are checked after preparation and before run. A formerly missing cache appearing, or any eligible cache/contract disappearing, invalidates the frozen run instead of changing its population.

features.reduction: Convert each original per-date cached spatial feature frame to float32, check all values finite, then np.mean over both spatial axes with float32 accumulation. No encoder, projector, LLM, or GPU.
features.delta: Not appended: mean(B)-mean(A) is linearly redundant with ordered [mean(A),mean(B)].
features.normalization: For each phenomenon and slot, train-only population mean/std (ddof0); scale<1e-6 becomes1. Pair concatenation preserves the same slot statistics. Test statistics never used.

fit.models: Separate fixed fit per phenomenon and arm, six total; no 3-seed duplication of a deterministic convex fit.
fit.loss: Mean class-balanced binary cross entropy; each sample weight N/(2*n_class), plus lambda/2 * sum(w^2); unpenalized intercept.
fit.convergence: Finite final model/logits/loss/gradient; final maximum absolute parameter gradient <=1e-5; final loss <=initial+1e-10. Failure marks the entire C0 run invalid; descriptive partial values may remain, no pass claim and no changed-setting retry.
fit.prediction: logit>=0 means yes; no threshold tuning

evaluation.population: Full frozen E2 test, not the smaller E3 subset.
evaluation.flood: Paired positives/negatives only, equal-event-macro BA; all event BA, recall, paired FPR, n and label counts recorded.
evaluation.hard_negatives: Separate per-event FPR, pooled FPR, equal-event-macro FPR and support; absent event support is omitted with no fake zero. Never merged into paired BA.
evaluation.contrast: later minus pair, computed within each event and then macro averaged.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired event bootstrap 5000 draws, numpy.default_rng(20260925); same event resample carries both arms; percentile 95% CI. No seed-replica uncertainty.
evaluation.landslide: Hiroshima and Indonesia fold-specific BA and equal-fold descriptive mean only; later-pair difference descriptive, CI null.
evaluation.tuple_counts: partition/phen/source-answer population counts plus cluster/kind/source-answer support in every metric table.

provenance.prepare: Exclusive new v1 output directory; preserve v0. Copy config/code; SHA256 current source JSONL/contracts and known E2 references; write explicit eligibility audit before indices/feature extraction, pin audit SHA plus sorted eligible train/test ID digests; hash each used embedding cache and archive ordered mean feature pairs/IDs. Recheck sources and eligibility after extraction.
provenance.run: Verify frozen code/config/items/features/eligibility-audit hashes, original source hashes, and full eligibility membership before fitting. Predictions and every coefficients/standardizer archive SHA256 tracked. Raw embedding hashes link features to the preparation inputs; run uses frozen features and does not reread large source tensors.
provenance.failure: Changed or malformed required source, eligibility change after freeze, duplicate/coverage/count/shape/date-slot mismatch, nonfinite eligible cache/feature, split overlap, incomplete pair, or solver failure -> invalid. Missing cache/contract at the initial E2 eligibility pass is disclosed in the frozen exclusion audit. All later failures remain fatal; no post-outcome deletion or repair.

limits: Source flood pre/pre no labels are pre-slot assumptions, not independently verified absence of flooding.
Flood dates are known imputed values, not recovered acquisition timestamps; earlier/later means E2 slot order.
S1 is flood and S2 is landslide; phenomenon and sensor remain confounded.
Exposed test regions/events support exploratory diagnosis only, not fresh unseen-test confirmation.
Pair model has twice as many coefficients as single-view models; input dimensions and parameter counts must be reported.
Global averaging and a linear boundary can lose spatial/nonlinear information; a low score does not establish failure of the complete embedding.
High single-view score shows association with source labels; high pair score or pair advantage does not prove change semantics, temporal reasoning, or physical causality.
launch: Main agent reviews config/code/tests before prepare/run. CPU only; no repository mutations or server jobs launched by the implementation subagent.

amendment.supersedes: C0-v0 preparation only; preserve original v0 files and failure record
amendment.v0_failure: QA included itogon_s2_586 without a cached embedding. C0 v0 incorrectly required every QA Q1 row to have a cache, while original E2 loader excluded missing caches/contracts before constructing its population.
amendment.no_outcomes_seen: Main agent reports v0 failed during prepare; no C0 model fits or C0 predictions were produced or inspected before this repair. Existing E2 outputs were already exposed as declared.
amendment.repair: Exactly reproduce E2 eligibility before date/slot parsing, explicitly record every excluded row and reason, freeze the complete eligibility input manifest before feature extraction and model fitting.
amendment.unchanged: Original eligible train/test counts, 3-seed E2 exact test ID contract, λ/optimizer/convergence criteria, feature definitions, full-test metrics, bootstrap, and absence of a primary scientific verdict remain unchanged. E3 is not modified.
amendment.additional_contract: For eligible flood rows: pos/hard_neg must use [pre_2,post]; neg must use [pre_1,pre_2]. Dates/NaNs in eligible rows remain fatal, with no post-freeze exclusion or reselection.
